version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Constant Contact integration with powerful but purpose-aligned read, write, automation, and OAuth capabilities that require user approval for sensitive actions.

dimensions.detail: Network access, OAuth, and marketing/contact data access are necessary for this integration, but users should recognize it can access personal contact data and send or schedule campaigns when authorized.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses pinned Maton CLI options through npm or Homebrew, with no bundled executable scripts in the artifact; raw HTTP with MATON_API_KEY is documented only as a fallback when the CLI cannot be installed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are broad because they include Maton function and trigger platform references, but they repeatedly scope ordinary Constant Contact use to API calls, require explicit approval for writes, and treat hosted automation, destinations, and local --exec handling as separate user-approved actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Maton login stores tokens in the OS credential store, and connections, hosted functions, triggers, and destinations can persist beyond one session; the artifact discloses this and gives approval, scoping, and cleanup guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly states it manages Constant Contact contacts, lists, campaigns, segments, bulk operations, and analytics, including write-capable operations; those capabilities match the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you need an agent to administer Constant Contact through Maton. Review every requested write, bulk operation, campaign send, function deploy, trigger, or destination carefully, confirm exact resource IDs and data flow, and revoke unused connections or automation when the task is done.
